nodes.description: Address of the current contract owner, set to msg.sender in the Owned constructor and checked by the onlyOwner modifier.
Pending owner address that must accept ownership via acceptOwnership before becoming owner.
Public token symbol string, set to MHCC in the token constructor.
Public token name string, set to Medical Health Care Coin.
Public token decimals value, set to 18.
Internal total token supply, fixed at construction time to 2700000000 * 10**decimals.
Mapping of holder address to token balance, mutated by transfer and transferFrom.
Nested mapping of owner to spender to allowance, mutated by approve, transferFrom and approveAndCall.
Caller-controlled address used for ownership assignment, authorization checks and balance/allowance bookkeeping.
Owned constructor that assigns msg.sender as the initial owner.
Owner-only function that stores a pending newOwner address pending acceptance.
Accepts ownership; requires msg.sender to equal newOwner, then transfers ownership and clears newOwner.
Token constructor that sets metadata, mints the fixed supply to owner and emits a Transfer event.
Returns _totalSupply minus balances[address(0)] using SafeMath.sub.
Returns the token balance of a given tokenOwner address from the balances mapping.
Transfers tokens from msg.sender to a recipient, updating balances and emitting Transfer.
Sets the allowance that msg.sender grants to a spender and emits Approval.
Spends an allowance to move tokens from an owner address to another address, updating balances and allowed.
Returns the remaining allowance a tokenOwner has granted to a spender.
Sets an allowance and then invokes the spender contract receiveApproval callback, performing an external call.
Payable fallback function that immediately reverts to reject plain ETH transfers.
Owner-only rescue function that performs an external call to an arbitrary token contract's transfer for the owner.
External call to arbitrary spender contract receiveApproval(msg.sender, tokens, this, data) inside approveAndCall, enabling reentrancy.
External call ERC20Interface(tokenAddress).transfer(owner, tokens) on an attacker-supplied token address inside transferAnyERC20Token.
SafeMath addition with overflow check require(c >= a).
SafeMath subtraction with underflow check require(b <= a).
SafeMath multiplication with overflow check require(a == 0 || c / a == b).
SafeMath division with zero-divisor check require(b > 0).
Interface callback declared in ApproveAndCallFallBack that approveAndCall invokes on the spender contract.
Parameter _newOwner of transferOwnership, stored into the newOwner state variable.
Parameter to (recipient) of transfer.
Parameter tokens (amount) of transfer, applied with SafeMath.sub and SafeMath.add.
Parameter spender of approve, used as key into the allowed mapping.
Parameter tokens (allowance amount) of approve.
Parameter from (source account) of transferFrom.
Parameter to (recipient) of transferFrom.
Parameter tokens (amount) of transferFrom, used for balance and allowance reductions.
Parameter tokenOwner of balanceOf, used as key into the balances mapping.
Parameter tokenOwner of allowance.
Parameter spender of allowance.
Parameter spender of approveAndCall; its contract is called via receiveApproval.
Parameter tokens of approveAndCall, set as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
Parameter data of approveAndCall, forwarded as raw call data to the spender contract.
Parameter tokenAddress of transferAnyERC20Token, used as the target of an external call.
Parameter tokens of transferAnyERC20Token, forwarded as the amount of the external call.
Parameter a of SafeMath.add.
Parameter b of SafeMath.add.
Parameter a of SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b of SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a of SafeMath.div.
Parameter b of SafeMath.div.
Return variable c of SafeMath.add holding the sum.
Return variable c of SafeMath.sub holding the difference.
Return variable c of SafeMath.mul holding the product.
Return variable c of SafeMath.div holding the quotient.
Return variable balance of balanceOf.

edges.reason: The constructor assigns caller-controlled msg.sender to the owner state variable, establishing the privileged account.
onlyOwner modifier compares msg.sender to owner before allowing transferOwnership, so the caller controls the authorization decision.
transferOwnership reads the owner state variable inside the onlyOwner authorization check.
The _newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership and written to storage.
The _newOwner parameter is assigned to the newOwner state variable pending acceptance.
acceptOwnership checks that the caller msg.sender equals the pending newOwner before granting ownership.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the caller authorization check and for the ownership transition.
acceptOwnership overwrites the privileged owner state variable with the accepted newOwner.
acceptOwnership clears newOwner to address(0) after the transfer completes.
The token constructor credits the entire fixed supply to the owner address in the balances mapping.
The constructor computes _totalSupply as 2700000000 * 10**uint(decimals), a fixed-point arithmetic supply calculation.
The constructor writes the initial minted balance into the balances mapping for owner.
The tokens parameter of transfer is arithmetically subtracted from and added to balances through SafeMath.
The to parameter of transfer selects the destination key of the balances mapping.
transfer uses msg.sender as the debit account and as the indexed event emitter.
transfer both reads and writes the balances state mapping for sender and recipient.
transfer delegates the balance subtraction to SafeMath.sub to prevent underflow.
transfer delegates the recipient credit to SafeMath.add to prevent overflow.
The tokens parameter of approve is stored as the allowance value.
The spender parameter of approve is used as the second key of the allowed mapping.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
approve overwrites the allowed allowance entry for msg.sender and spender.
The from parameter of transferFrom selects the debited balance and allowance owner.
The to parameter of transferFrom selects the credited balance recipient.
The tokens parameter of transferFrom is arithmetically reduced from both balance and allowance.
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
transferFrom updates the balances mapping for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decrements the allowed allowance entry for from and msg.sender.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance reductions.
transferFrom uses SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
The tokenOwner parameter of balanceOf is the lookup key into the balances mapping.
balanceOf reads the balances state mapping.
The tokenOwner parameter of allowance is the first lookup key into allowed.
The spender parameter of allowance is the second lookup key into allowed.
allowance reads the allowed nested mapping.
The spender parameter of approveAndCall is both an allowance key and the external call target.
The tokens parameter of approveAndCall is stored as allowance and forwarded to the callback.
The data parameter of approveAndCall is forwarded verbatim as calldata to the spender contract.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as the allowance owner and as the from argument of the callback.
approveAndCall writes the allowed allowance entry before performing the external call.
approveAndCall performs the external receiveApproval call on an arbitrary spender-provided contract.
The called spender contract can re-enter token functions and manipulate the allowed allowance state.
The called spender contract can re-enter token functions and manipulate the balances state.
The tokenAddress parameter of transferAnyERC20Token is used as the external call target contract.
The tokens parameter of transferAnyERC20Token is forwarded as the external call amount.
transferAnyERC20Token is guarded by onlyOwner and sends rescued tokens to the owner address.
transferAnyERC20Token performs an external call to an attacker-supplied token contract.
The arbitrary token contract invoked can re-enter or return arbitrary success while the rescue call is in flight.
Re-entrancy through the external token transfer can disturb the balances state during the rescue operation.
Parameter a flows into the SafeMath.add result computation.
Parameter b flows into the SafeMath.add result computation.
The local c holds the result and is validated by require(c >= a) in SafeMath.add.
Parameter a flows into SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b flows into SafeMath.sub and gates the require(b <= a) check.
The local c holds the difference computed by SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a flows into SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b flows into SafeMath.mul.
The local c holds the product validated by the overflow require clause.
Parameter a flows into SafeMath.div.
Parameter b flows into SafeMath.div and gates the require(b > 0) check.
The local c holds the quotient computed by SafeMath.div.
The local balance return variable is populated from the balances mapping in balanceOf.
totalSupply reads _totalSupply and subtracts balances[address(0)] via SafeMath.sub.
totalSupply delegates its burn-adjusted supply calculation to SafeMath.sub.
The receiveApproval interface function is the callback entry point invoked by external call 22.
The Owned constructor sets the owner state variable, defining all subsequent privileged access.
The payable fallback executes for any caller msg.sender but unconditionally reverts, rejecting ETH.

normalization_plan.reason: The _newOwner parameter only exists to be stored into newOwner by transferOwnership.
The to parameter is only used as the recipient key inside transfer.
The tokens parameter is only used for the SafeMath balance arithmetic inside transfer.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowance key inside approve.
The tokens parameter is only written to the allowed mapping inside approve.
The from parameter is only used as the source account inside transferFrom.
The to parameter is only used as the destination account inside transferFrom.
The tokens parameter is only used for balance and allowance arithmetic inside transferFrom.
The tokenOwner parameter is only used as the balances lookup key inside balanceOf.
The tokenOwner parameter is only used as the allowed lookup key inside allowance.
The spender parameter is only used as the allowed lookup key inside allowance.
The spender parameter is used as allowance key and external call target inside approveAndCall.
The tokens parameter is only used as allowance value and callback argument inside approveAndCall.
The data parameter is only forwarded to the external receiveApproval call inside approveAndCall.
The tokenAddress parameter is only used as the external call target of transferAnyERC20Token.
The tokens parameter is only forwarded as the external call amount of the rescue function.
Parameter a is only consumed by the addition logic of SafeMath.add.
Parameter b is only consumed by the addition logic of SafeMath.add.
Parameter a is only consumed by the subtraction logic of SafeMath.sub.
Parameter b is only consumed by the subtraction logic of SafeMath.sub.
Parameter a is only consumed by the multiplication logic of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter b is only consumed by the multiplication logic of SafeMath.mul.
Parameter a is only consumed by the division logic of SafeMath.div.
Parameter b is only consumed by the division logic of SafeMath.div.
The local c is the arithmetic result buffer of SafeMath.add and has no meaning outside it.
The local c is the arithmetic result buffer of SafeMath.sub and has no meaning outside it.
The local c is the arithmetic result buffer of SafeMath.mul and has no meaning outside it.
The local c is the arithmetic result buffer of SafeMath.div and has no meaning outside it.
The local balance is the return buffer of balanceOf read directly from the balances mapping.
